text:
Rae M.: Quick note — candidate (Sam K) asked for a few accessibility things for Tuesday's onsite: noise-cancelling headphones, a private quiet room between interviews, and permission to bring a small service dog. Also asked if we offer a childcare stipend for travel day.
Oliver (Recruiter): Thanks Rae. Candidate is traveling with partner and toddler, arriving evening before. Wants to know if overnight childcare stipend is possible or if we have a room where the toddler can nap while partner waits.
Nia (People Ops): We don't usually offer childcare stipend, but we can approve a one-off childcare reimbursement up to $150 if pre-approved. Ask candidate to submit receipt with dates.
Rae M.: I'll confirm that with Sam. For the service dog — any legal issues?
Nia (People Ops): Service animals are allowed. We'll notify security and reception to avoid issues at badge pickup. Please ask candidate to bring documentation if available but do not require medical proof.
Facilities Bot: Quiet room reserve: "Q-Quiet-2" booked 10:20-10:40 and 12:10-12:30. Noise-cancelling headphones: 1x reserved (label: "Sam K - ANC").
Oliver (Recruiter): Can we also ensure the interview room has softened lighting and avoid fluorescent if possible? Candidate mentioned sensory sensitivity to bright lights.
Facilities Bot: Meeting room "3B - Cove" set to warm lighting. AV tech will confirm dimmer setting.
Rae M.: Parking question — candidate might drive; is validation available and is there an accessible drop-off near the entrance?
Nia (People Ops): We can validate parking at reception and there's a curbside drop-off by the east lobby with accessible ramp. Add note in email.
Oliver (Recruiter): On the schedule side, candidate prefers a 30-min buffer between technical rounds. Is that feasible?
Nia (People Ops): Yes — shifting internal assignments now. ops-bot: Calendar updated: added 30-min buffers after tech sessions and blocked quiet room slots.
Rae M.: Also candidate asked about dietary: Kosher lunch request and milk alternatives (oat).
Facilities Bot: Catering: Kosher box + oat milk latte marked.
Oliver (Recruiter): For travel reimbursements, candidate is taking BART + short rideshare. We reimburse receipts; for BART we need timestamped proof (screenshot ok) — is that correct?
Nia (People Ops): Correct. Candidate should email receipts to expenses@redwood.com with subject "Candidate Travel - Sam K". For BART screenshots, include time and origin/destination.
Rae M.: One more — candidate asked if the interview can run hybrid (in-person for coding, remote for behavioral) because of childcare pickup window. Is that allowed?
Nia (People Ops): Hybrid split ok. Reserve Zoom for the behavioral panel and ensure captions enabled. I'll add notes to the invites.
visitor-bot: Visitor pre-registration created. Front desk will print badge and note "service animal on premise".
Oliver (Recruiter): I'll message candidate with the childcare reimbursement terms, quiet room, service dog confirmation, parking, and hybrid option. Thanks everyone — please flag if anything can't be done.
Nia (People Ops): All set on our end. If candidate sends receipts, expedite approval. :white_check_mark:
Rae M.: Closing loop. I'll DM follow-ups to facilities and security. :seedling:
